req.title: Basic-auth requires both segments
req.statement: The system shall route /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> only when both user and passwd segments are provided.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must only route when BOTH path segments are present. Tests cover: (1) positive EP - valid credentials with both segments returns 200 and correct JSON payload; (2) negative NEG - missing passwd segment causes 404 (route not matched); (3) negative NEG - missing both segments causes 404; (4) DT - wrong credentials with both segments returns 401; (5) BVA - single-character user and passwd at boundary; (6) DT - correct user but wrong passwd returns 401 (boolean invariant: both user AND passwd must match). Each test asserts exact status codes and payload fields to kill comparison-operator and constant mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_both_segments_returns_200
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
Both user and passwd path segments are provided
Correct Basic Auth credentials are sent
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with correct Basic Auth header
Assert JSON body contains authenticated=True and user='testuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-049: both segments provided, valid credentials -> 200 + payload
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()
creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'testuser'
assert 'authenticated' in data
assert 'user' in data
assert len(data) == 2

def test_basic_auth_valid_credentials_both_segments_returns_200():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('ascii')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'testuser'
    assert len(data) == 2
